layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-white relative overflow-x-hidden flex flex-col shadow-2xl md:my-8 md:rounded-[2.5rem] md:min-h-[850px] md:max-h-[850px]

button.primary: w-full h-14 bg-black text-white rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold hover:bg-neutral-800 transition-colors
button.secondary: w-full h-14 bg-transparent border-2 border-[#E6E0F8] text-black rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold hover:bg-[#F5F3F7] transition-colors
button.disabled: w-full h-14 bg-neutral-200 text-neutral-400 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold cursor-not-allowed

input.default: w-full h-14 bg-[#F5F3F7] text-black rounded-2xl px-4 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black transition-all placeholder:text-neutral-400
input.phone: flex items-center w-full h-14 bg-[#F5F3F7] rounded-2xl px-4 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-black transition-all text-black

bottomNav.container: absolute bottom-0 w-full bg-white border-t border-neutral-100 flex justify-around items-center px-2 py-3 pb-safe z-50 rounded-b-none md:rounded-b-[2.5rem]
bottomNav.item: flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-600 transition-colors cursor-pointer w-16
bottomNav.itemActive: flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 text-black cursor-pointer w-16

images.onboarding_illustration: Use lucide-react 'Telescope' icon (or similar line-art SVG like 'User'/'Binoculars') with large size (e.g., size={160}), strokeWidth={1} in black color.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Build a mobile-first UI wrapped in the provided 'container' classes (max-w-md mx-auto) to simulate a mobile app on desktop.
Use 'Manrope' for both headings and body texts in tailwind.config.js.
Follow the exact monochrome aesthetic: pure white/very light lavender backgrounds, deep black text and primary buttons. NO gradients.
Onboarding Screen: Center the illustration (Lucide icon), bold H1 title below it, Primary black button ('Хочу войти и выполнить заказ'), text secondary button below ('Хочу заказать услугу').

Phone Login Screen: Light lavender/grey background. Back arrow top left, H1 title ('Ваш номер'). Phone input with flag emoji + country code. Disabled bottom button when empty, active black button & outlined secondary button when filled.
Add a language toggle (RU/RO) in the top right of appropriate screens.
Ensure generous spacing (p-6, gap-6) between elements. Use flex-1 to push CTA buttons to the bottom of the screen.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for automated testing.
